_caveats.interval_calibration: The 95% intervals are NOMINALLY 95% but EMPIRICALLY UNCALIBRATED. The bce_dup control is byte-identical SPIR-V, so its true ratio is 1.0 and its interval's exclusion rate IS the type-I error of every reported interval. Measured on the stored runs: realworld-2 Intel 70.1% (nominal 5%), v4 NVIDIA 15.7%. Artifact: bounds-check-testing-framework/runs-v4/control-calibration-20261001.json
_caveats.rule_v2_coverage: The registered rule-v2 across-process t-interval was ALSO measured on the control and is mis-calibrated: realworld-2 Intel 73.7% of workload control intervals exclude the null, NVIDIA 42.1%. On the `empty` kernel, where d = e - c must be exactly 0, the estimator gave +0.1369% (19ffb4e) and +0.2862% (83a90e0) on NVIDIA.
_caveats.apparatus_floor: Measured noise floor of the headline metric d = ln(effect) - ln(control) is ~0.14% to ~0.29%. Effects at or below that are not measurements. Under the secondary analysis (analyze_v3.py) 22 of 38 NVIDIA workloads fall below it.
_caveats.intel_run_validity: realworld-2 Intel: 136 of 180 runs are flagged valid=false by the harness's own gate (valid = correct && control_ok && quiet_during_run), leaving 44 usable. The Intel +7.01% headline and its 22 GAIN / 10 LOSS tally were computed WITHOUT honouring that flag (audit F10). Only 44 runs survive it.
_caveats.intel_clock_state: The entire Intel result set was measured at 210 MHz in P8 (runs-v4: 210 MHz flat, P8 only; realworld: 210-600 MHz, P5/P8). meta.json records gpu_display_active=Disabled in all 1338 runs. The Intel numbers are a low-power-state measurement, not production-representative.
_caveats.vello_scenes_not_independent: All 34 vello scenes compile the SAME 20 shaders: exactly 1 distinct bce SPIR-V sha256 across all 34. They are one shader program with 34 input scenes, not 34 independent tests.
_caveats.clamp_vs_proven: 102 UMin clamps removed vs 93 accesses in safe_accesses; the entire +9 gap is one shader (fine_area, 31 removed vs 22 proven). Artifact: bounds-check-testing-framework/runs-v4/clamp-reconciliation-20261001.json
_caveats.multiplicity: 76 intervals tested at alpha=0.05 with no family-wise or FDR adjustment. ~3.8 false GAIN/LOSS labels expected under a global null.
_caveats.analysis_registered_secondary: analyze_v2.py is the PRE-REGISTERED primary rule (commit 98bd514) and is unchanged in its verdict semantics. analyze_v3.py (multiplicity-corrected, four-outcome, noise floor) is a DECLARED SECONDARY analysis. Report both; never only v3.
